title: Binary summary
description: What inspect-binary extracts from a build artefact: enough for the verifier to check that a claimed change reached machine code, and nothing that depends on one toolchain's output format.

toolchain.description: Which disassembler or dump produced this, e.g. 'objdump', 'a vendor ISA dump'.

instructions.description: Instruction mnemonic summary, most frequent first: the vocabulary a check cites.

load_widths.description: Widths in bytes of the loads seen, so a claimed wide load is checkable.
